Colornear: Wire colour for surfaces close to the camera (at Depthnear).
Colorfar: Wire colour for surfaces far from the camera (at Depthfar).
Scancolor: Colour of the sweeping scan band.
Wirewidth: Wire line thickness in screen pixels.
Wirebright: Brightness multiplier of the wire lines.
Fill: Brightness of the faint surface fill between wires. 0 = wires only.
Wiremode: Wire source. objectgrid: object-space lattice, works on any mesh. uvgrid: iso-lines of the UVs (needs UVs). both: draw both.
Gridcells: Cells per object-space unit for the objectgrid lattice. Higher = denser wires.
Griduv: Number of UV grid cells in U and V for the uvgrid wires (Z/W unused).
Creases: Strength of extra lines on sharp normal discontinuities and silhouettes. 0 = off.
Fresnelpower: Sharpness of the rim glow. Higher = thinner rim at grazing angles.
Fresnelamount: Strength of the rim glow. 0 = off.
Scansweeps: Number of scan band sweeps per preview cycle (8 s). Integer so the loop is seamless.
Scanscale: Spatial size of the scan band along world Y. Larger = wider band.
Scansharp: Falloff sharpness of the band. Higher = thinner, crisper band.
Scanstrength: Brightness of the scan band. 0 = off.
Scanlinepx: Spacing of the fine screen-space scanlines in pixels.
Scanlineamount: Darkening depth of the scanlines. 0 = none.
Dropamount: Fraction of screen blocks discarded as data dropout. 0 = none.
Dropblock: Size of the dropout blocks in pixels. Lower = finer glitching.
Droprate: How many times per second the dropout pattern is re-rolled.
Flicker: Strength of global brightness flicker. 0 = steady.
Depthnear: Camera distance, in world units, that maps to Colornear.
Depthfar: Camera distance, in world units, that maps to Colorfar.
Blend: Blending mode. additive: adds light to the background (best on black). transparent: normal alpha blending.
Backfaces: On: also draw back faces for a see-through hologram. Off: front faces only.
Modamount: Scale of the in1 modulation CHOP. 0 = ignore it.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Turns: Whole rotations of the preview objects per preview cycle (8 s).
Background: Background colour of the preview render.
Camdistance: Preview camera distance in world units.
Showtorus: Show the torus in the preview.
Showsphere: Show the sphere in the preview.
